1.7.0.changelog:
• Spelling and syntax fixes
  • Changed the auger unit from ms to ds
  • Added a date picker to the home page
  • Displayed curve names in curve order
  • Added a 'Real Time' page
    • View boiler combustion and regulation settings
    • View real-time charts
    • Save the boiler configuration
    • Change boiler settings through Okovision
    • Reload saved settings and modify the boiler settings
    • View boiler setting changes on daily charts
  • Removed the matrix without losing historical data (daily data is deleted)
